# Future independent execution assignment

**Not executable in this preparation slice.** The coordinator must first have
separately proven guest-native tooling; missing capability is BLOCKED.

Provide exact source/build candidate, original artifact/signature, installed
artifact/signature and any transformation, running instance, test revision/tree
hash, selected IDs and feature context. Include expected behavior, actual
independent dispatch reference, dedicated guest identity, isolated profile and
test credential namespace, declared baseline and ownership/termination duties.
Different actor strings are not proof of independent assignment.

The verifier checks the actual artifact, production Tauri frontend, signature,
instance and effective isolated namespace before acting. It does not rebuild,
patch app/tests/expectations, install a different candidate or re-sign a copy.
Original release and transformed test-copy evidence remain separately qualified.

Acquire atomic guest-wide ownership before any native action; existing or
uncertain ownership reports busy/BLOCKED without removing the claim. Use only
guest-local actions and observations. No host viewer/input, screenshots of
unrelated desktop content, real account use, provider mutations or paid inference.
Capture current, case/attempt/candidate/instance-bound observations, not successful
command dispatch, browser-only fixtures or internal Store state as native proof.

Always restore the baseline and verify owned instance/child termination, even
after assertion failure. Retain ownership while termination/restoration is
uncertain; report recovery needed. Never steal another run's state. A later
retry uses a new attempt ID and keeps previous failures. Only shut down a guest
when this assignment owns that action; otherwise transfer custody explicitly.

Return candidate/test/dispatch provenance, exact selected and executed IDs,
unexecuted coverage, raw per-case verdicts, separate expected negative controls,
observations and artifact hashes, limitations, cleanup and ownership residue.
Potential bugs need expected/actual behavior, safe reproduction and evidence;
they are unverified by the main agent. No tracker writes or competing repair
loop. The main agent validates and routes; it does not rewrite your verdict.
